title: p5.brush handwriting and painted photo
what_it_does: Deterministic p5.js scripts: pencil handwriting that writes itself, a photo repainted as brush strokes, a clip repainted frame by frame.
when_to_use: Hand-made title or photo moments; low priority for data explainers.
why: Apache-2.0 and offline, no image model. Optional extra, not part of the minimum set.
